# GitHub topics still carry the monorepo-era Brain terms — re-topic the engine as the Body

## Context

Operator sighting 2026-09-04: after the repository split, the org's GitHub metadata never followed. Measured with `gh repo view` and each `package.json` the same day:

| repo | GitHub description | GitHub topics | `package.json` keywords |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `neomjs/neo` | present (the organism sentence) | **20 — the monorepo-era mix**: `agent-memory, ai-agent, ai-memory, context-engineering, frontend, frontend-runtime, graph-rag, javascript, json, knowledge-graph, llm, long-term-memory, mcp, mcp-server, multi-agent-systems, rag, scene-graph, semantic-search, web-workers, ai` | 40, Body-shaped (curated post-split; not this ticket) |
| `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` | empty | 0 | 35 |
| `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` | empty | 0 | 0 |
| `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` | empty | 0 | 3 |

This ticket is the engine's leaf: its topics still describe the Brain that moved out. Siblings: neo-agent-brain, neo-agent-institution and neo-agent-skills each carry their own leaf (filed the same day).

Live latest-open sweep: no open issue mentions topics, keywords or the repository description in its title (searched 2026-09-04T13:47Z). A2A claim sweep: none.

## The Problem

GitHub topics are the org's discovery surface — topic pages, search facets, the "Explore" graph. Nine of the engine's twenty describe substrate that lives in `neo-agent-brain` since the split (`agent-memory`, `ai-memory`, `graph-rag`, `knowledge-graph`, `long-term-memory`, `rag`, `semantic-search`, `mcp-server`, `context-engineering`); a developer arriving through `graph-rag` lands on the Body. Meanwhile the Body's own identity (`application-engine`, `sharedworker`, `multi-window`, `virtual-dom`, `offscreencanvas`, `pwa`, `zero-build`) has no topic at all.

## The Architectural Reality

- Topics are repository settings (admin write via the web UI or `gh repo edit --add-topic/--remove-topic`); they are not in git, so this is a checklist ticket for the operator's hands, not a PR. Limits: 20 topics, lowercase, letters/digits/hyphens, ≤ 50 chars each.
- The repository description on `neomjs/neo` is the organism's front-door sentence (README.md frames Neo as the organism, not a web framework — per `.claude/CLAUDE.md` §neo_identity_anchor); it stays. The topics should carry BOTH the umbrella (`ai`, `ai-agent`, `multi-agent-systems`, `mcp`) and the Body's own vocabulary; the Brain-only terms move to the Brain's leaf.
- `package.json` keywords (40, e.g. `application-engine`, `sharedworker`, `multi-window-applications`, `object-permanence`, `zero-build-development`) are already the Body's vocabulary — the topic list below is derived from them, so npm and GitHub say the same thing.

## The Fix

Replace the topic set with (20, proposal — the operator's call on wording):

`javascript, json, ai, ai-agent, multi-agent-systems, mcp, application-engine, frontend-runtime, web-workers, sharedworker, offscreencanvas, multi-window, scene-graph, virtual-dom, object-permanence, pwa, zero-build, esm, desktop-class-web-apps, self-evolving-software`

Removed (to the Brain's leaf): `agent-memory, ai-memory, context-engineering, graph-rag, knowledge-graph, llm, long-term-memory, mcp-server, rag, semantic-search`; `frontend` folds into `frontend-runtime`.

Apply with:

```bash
gh repo edit neomjs/neo --remove-topic agent-memory --remove-topic ai-memory --remove-topic context-engineering --remove-topic graph-rag --remove-topic knowledge-graph --remove-topic llm --remove-topic long-term-memory --remove-topic mcp-server --remove-topic rag --remove-topic semantic-search --remove-topic frontend
gh repo edit neomjs/neo --add-topic application-engine --add-topic sharedworker --add-topic offscreencanvas --add-topic multi-window --add-topic virtual-dom --add-topic object-permanence --add-topic pwa --add-topic zero-build --add-topic esm --add-topic desktop-class-web-apps --add-topic self-evolving-software
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 `gh repo view neomjs/neo --json repositoryTopics` lists 20 topics, none of the ten Brain-only terms, all of the Body terms above (or the operator's edited list — the final list is recorded in a closing comment).
- [ ] AC-2 The repository description is unchanged (the organism sentence) or deliberately revised in the closing comment.
- [ ] AC-3 The sibling leaves are filed and cross-linked (brain, institution, skills) so the removed terms have a new home before they are removed here.

## Out of Scope

- `package.json` keywords of the engine (already curated post-split).
- The other repos (each has its own leaf).

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-09-15T20:28:09Z

**Do not run this leaf's `--remove-topic` step as written yet** — measured 2026-09-15, full table at https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/309#issuecomment-5687621688.

Four of the eleven removals have no home in `neo-agent-brain`'s applied topic list: **`graph-rag`, `long-term-memory`, `ai-memory`**, plus `frontend`, which is meant to go. AC-3 exists so removed terms *"have a new home before they are removed here"*; as written, this step deletes those three from the org entirely.

`neo-agent-brain` is at GitHub's 20-topic cap, so a home is a swap there, not an addition. That makes it an operator call: trim this removal list, or swap them in on the Brain first.

Separately: the four umbrella terms this leaf keeps on purpose (`ai`, `ai-agent`, `mcp`, `multi-agent-systems`) are already carried by all four repos. That is consistent with this ticket, and it makes `neo-agent-brain#309`'s AC-2 (*"no term lives on both"*) unsatisfiable. An amendment is proposed there, not here.
